build_gaussian_rbf_layer: build a GaussianRadialBasisLayer module with a specified number of basis functions and cutoff distance
run_gaussian_function: run the JIT-compiled gaussian function to compute Gaussian values for input tensors with given mean and std
test_gaussian_rbf_forward: test the GaussianRadialBasisLayer forward pass by passing distance tensors and verifying output shape
review_gaussian_rbf_initialization: review the GaussianRadialBasisLayer initialization to inspect learnable mean, std, weight, and bias parameters
refactor_gaussian_rbf_cutoff: refactor the GaussianRadialBasisLayer to customize the cutoff normalization and linear scaling of input distances
